Dubai project is launch-ready with all regulatory approvals in place, but timing is recalibrated due to ongoing regional situations; total investment in the project is close to ₹200-225 Cr.

Wholly owned subsidiary acquired approximately 4.5 acres of land adjacent to New Link Road, Borivali West, Mumbai.
Company adopted concessional tax regime under Section 115BAA during the period.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹339.04 Cr (+64.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹63.75 Cr.
Sunteck Realty Ltd’s Board, led by **Vipul Hingarajia** and **Rachana Hingarajia**, recommended a final dividend of ₹1.50 per share (150% of face value) on April 21, 2026, pending AGM approval.
Monitoring Agency reported nil deviation for Sunteck's ₹499.99 Cr warrant issue, with ₹136.25 Cr received and fully deployed toward land buys as of March 31, 2026.
Sunteck Realty uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call.
Sunteck Realty acquired 100% stake in Tanirika Infrastructure Private Limited for an enterprise value of ~₹22.40 Cr.
Sunteck Realty reported Q4 FY26 operating revenue of ₹339.04 Cr and annual pre-sales of ₹3,157 Cr, up 25% YoY.
India Ratings affirmed Sunteck Realty's issuer rating at IND AA/Stable and assigned/affirmed bank loan ratings at IND AA/Stable/IND A1+, while withdrawing proposed NCDs.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹191.56 Cr (+1.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹42.28 Cr.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹191.56 Cr; net profit to shareholders ₹42.28 Cr.
Sunteck Realty uploaded the audio recording of its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call.
Sunteck Realty reported Q1FY27 earnings call details, highlighting a 20% YoY growth in presales to ₹787 Cr and reiterating its 25-30% growth guidance.
Sunteck Realty released its 43rd Annual Report for FY2026, highlighting record pre-sales of ₹3,157 crore and robust cash flow surpluses.
Sunteck Realty Limited’s 43rd AGM held on September 24, 2026, approved all business items with requisite shareholder majority via video conferencing.
2026-09-24: Sunteck Realty received GST SCN for ₹59.44 Cr related to TDR procurement in FY22-23
2026-10-01: Sunteck Realty announced credit rating affirmations from India Ratings at IND AA/Stable and commercial paper rating of IND A1+.
Sunteck Realty approved a scheme of arrangement with its wholly owned subsidiary Satguru Corporate Services and appointed EY as internal auditor.
Sunteck Realty approved a scheme of arrangement for the demerger of Satguru Corporate Services' Sunteck City 4th Avenue undertaking into the parent company.
Sunteck Realty's wholly owned subsidiary acquired approximately 4.5 acres of land in Borivali West, Mumbai, on October 5, 2026.
Sunteck Realty issued ₹70 Cr commercial paper at 7.75% p.a. maturing on 19 April 2027.
Sunteck Realty Ltd. scheduled Q2 and H1 FY 2027 earnings conference call with **Mr. Kamal Khetan** and senior management on **October 27, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST** via Chorus Call.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹320.81 Cr (+27.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹58.17 Cr (+347.5% YoY).
Sunteck Realty's ₹499.99 Cr warrant issue subscribed as on 30th September 2026
Sunteck Realty reported Q2FY27 pre-sales of ₹824 Cr and expanded its total GDV to ₹46,880 Cr.
Audio recording of Q2 and H1 FY 2027 earnings conference call uploaded to company website on 27 October 2026.
